Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.79 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 36-month contract; option B: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 36-month contract; option C: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 1362276 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Beyond this part, we buy Sheet 1.4301 2 mm, 2B, cut to size from another supplier today, in a volume close to this bar's, and you have quoted it for us before. Once this agreement is signed, we will invite you to quote for it. Our orders for this bar rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within nine months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10). Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: Please send us your cost breakdown for this part. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
